page.overview:
Who is Dango Mitsuki?

While much is not know about Dango, it was stated that he has good observational skills. In his spare time, he likes to look at the moon.

Dango is a young man with dark hair and small, dark-coloured eyes. Because of his hobby of looking at the moon, he squints. He wears the typical Konoha-nin attire complete with a bandanna-styled forehead protector and flak jacket.

He is part of the iteration of the Infiltration and Reconnaissance Party that tracks Kabuto Yakushi to the Mountains' Graveyard. While there, he is shocked to learn that Kabuto has teamed up with Tobi.
